fact: The WURI Niger project says it is developing a National Population Register meant to identify and authenticate anyone requesting public or private services that require prior identification, with a first enrolment phase in Niamey's five arrondissements to start in the coming weeks.

WURI-Niger's Component 3 funds the commissioning of an interoperability framework to offer identity verification and authentication services to public and private service providers; banks, telecom operators, money transfer firms, social protection, tax and social security bodies are named as direct beneficiaries, with no service stated as in use.
system: cadre d'interopérabilité et d'échanges sécurisés de données (WURI-Niger Component 3)

fact: Niger signed an MoU on 27 June 2025 with Libyan firm Al Itissal Al Jadeed for a new electronic national ID card enabling secure online identification, aimed at online authentication, e-government, banking and social protection.
